shots.name: lax_final_close
shots.pos: const M = en.sky.model, a = M.airports.LAX, e = M.runway('LAX', '24R'); return M.along(a, e, e.displ - 1000, 170);
shots.js: const k = en.sky, M = k.model, t = k.now(), b = Math.floor(t / 3600); const f = M.arrivals('LAX', b).concat(M.arrivals('LAX', b + 1)).filter(f => f.rw === '24R' && f.t0 > t + 30)[0]; k.hold(f.t0 - 13.2); return f.type.key;
shots.check: const k = en.sky, f = k.flights.filter(p => p.kind === 'arr' && p.f.rw === '24R' && p.dist > 0).sort((a, b) => a.dist - b.dist)[0], c = en.engine.camera.entity.transform.position; return f ? { type: f.f.type.key, dist_m: Math.round(f.dist), y: +f.y.toFixed(1), want: +((55 * 0.3048) + Math.tan(3 * Math.PI / 180) * f.dist).toFixed(1), from_cam: Math.round(Math.hypot(f.x - c[0], f.z - c[2])), gear: f.gear } : null;

shots.name: lax_final_night
shots.pos: const M = en.sky.model, a = M.airports.LAX, e = M.runway('LAX', '24R'); return M.along(a, e, e.displ - 1000, 170);
shots.js: const k = en.sky, M = k.model; k.hold(null); const t = k.now(), b = Math.floor(t / 3600); const f = M.arrivals('LAX', b).concat(M.arrivals('LAX', b + 1)).filter(f => f.rw === '24R' && f.t0 > t + 30)[0]; k.hold(f.t0 - 15); return [f.type.key, M.hourOf(k.now())];

shots.name: lax_runway_night_drone
shots.pos: const M = en.sky.model, a = M.airports.LAX, e = M.runway('LAX', '24R'); return M.along(a, e, e.displ - 1500, 0);

shots.name: coronado_helo_ferry
shots.check: const k = en.sky; return { helos: (k.heloList || []).map(h => [Math.round(h.alt / 0.3048), Math.round(h.v)]), vessels: (k.vesselList || []).map(v => v.kind + ' ' + v.v.toFixed(1)) };

shots.name: bay_bridge_embarcadero
shots.check: const d = en.sky.decks.find(x => x.name === 'Bay Bridge, west span'), K = d.loc.K, t = en.sky.tools, s = (K.W2 + K.W3) / 2, p = t.pointAt(d, s); return { W2W3: Math.round(K.W3 - K.W2), W5W6: Math.round(K.W6 - K.W5), upper: +en.world.deckAt(p.x, p.z).toFixed(1), lower: +en.world.deckAt(p.x, p.z, { lower: true }).toFixed(1), built: en.sky.info().built };

shots.name: vincent_thomas
shots.check: const d = en.sky.decks.find(x => x.name === 'Vincent Thomas Bridge'), K = d.loc.K, t = en.sky.tools, s = (K.W + K.E) / 2, p = t.pointAt(d, s); return { towers: Math.round(K.E - K.W), mid: +en.world.deckAt(p.x, p.z).toFixed(1), L: Math.round(d.loc.L) };
